name: diving-fin
description: A diving fin with an open foot pocket and a long ribbed blade.
useCase: Identify diving fins or swim propulsion equipment.
misuse: Use a visible label when equipment identifies a sport, product or activity.

16.reason: A short open foot pocket joins the broad blade above its central reinforcing rib.

24.reason: The full foot pocket and long blade retain clear openings on either side of the central rib.
